high_level_description: The Clarth hunters' camp on a floating snowy island, ringed by a wall of sand shark spines with a gate made of a shark jaw, hunters with spine rifles on the wall, hooded Bloodridge raiders climbing the ice cliff on the right.

style_description.aesthetics: a lived in war camp seen from a little above, busy with small figures, warm against cold snow
style_description.lighting: warm sunlight from the upper right, short blue shadows falling to the lower left
style_description.art_style: crisp pixel art with clean dark outlines, flat shading in few colours, figures a few pixels tall

compositional_deconstruction.background: a floating island with a flat snowy top and blue ice cliffs, over a white sea of clouds, under a clear blue sky

elements.desc: a wall of tall sand shark spines around the camp, a gate made of a huge shark jaw
Clarth hunters in red cloaks on the wall aiming spine rifles toward the right
red hide tents inside the wall
hooded raiders in rotted sepia rags climbing the ice cliff with hooked flails
